name: Moose On The Loose Cubikon 2022

venue.name: Wasserman Park Function Hall
venue.details: Park in either lot - right inside entrance or near Dog Park and exit. Follow signs to the Function Hall.

information: This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the WCA regulations. If you are new to competing, please refer to the Competitor Responsibilities tab.
